resources.string: DAR HAAL-E ZANG: PEYDA KARDAN-E GOOSHI
GOOSHI RO BAZ KONID YA STOP RO BEZANID
JOFT NASHODE. REGISTER RO BAZ KONID TA JOFT KONID.

ROOYE IPHONE DOORBIN RO BAZ KONID, ROOYE IN CODE BEGIRID VA "OPEN IN REGISTER" RO BEZANID (YA DAR REGISTER: ETTESAL › JOFT KARDAN BA GOOSHI-E ANDROID). VAGHTI IPHONE PORSID BLUETOOTH RO MOJAZ KONID. CODE FAGHAT YEK BAR KAR MIKONE VA BAAD AZ 5 DAGHIGHE MONGHAZI MISHE.
IN MARAHEL RO YEK BAR, AZ BALA BE PAEEN ANJAM BEDID. HAR MARHALE MIGE CHI KAR KONID; VAGHTI SABZ SHOD YANI ANJAM SHODE.

"EJAZE" RO BEZANID VA HAME CHIZI KE REGISTER MIKHAD RO MOJAZ KONID: TELEPHONE, PAYAMAK, MOKHATABIN, SABEGHE-E TAMAS, DASTGAHHAYE NAZDIK (BLUETOOTH) VA NOTIFICATIONHA. REGISTER ONHA RO FAGHAT BE IPHONE-ETOON MIRESOONE; HICHI AZ DASTGAHHATOON BIROON NEMIRE.
"TANZIM" RO BEZANID VA REGISTER RO APP-E PISHFARZ-E TELEPHONE KONID TA BESHE AZ IPHONE TAMAS GEREFT VA JAVAB DAD.
"TANZIM" RO BEZANID VA MASRAF-E BATRI-E BEDOON-E MAHDOODIYAT RO MOJAZ KONID TA ANDROID REGISTER RO VAGHTI GOOSHI TOOYE KIFE MOTEVAGHEF NAKONE.

FAGHAT YEK BAR, WI-FI LAZEME. DEVELOPER OPTIONS RO ROSHAN KONID (SETTINGS › ABOUT PHONE › SOFTWARE INFORMATION: 7 BAR ROOYE BUILD NUMBER BEZANID). "JOFT" RO BEZANID: REGISTER DEVELOPER OPTIONS RO BAZ MIKONE VA YE NOTIFICATION MIFERESTE. WIRELESS DEBUGGING RO ROSHAN KONID, "PAIR DEVICE WITH PAIRING CODE" RO BEZANID, BAAD CODE-E 6 RAGHAMI RO DAR NOTIFICATION-E REGISTER VARED KONID. BA IN KAR REGISTER MITOONE SEDAYE TAMAS RO MONTAGHEL KONE.
BAADI: "JOFT KARDAN BA IPHONE" RO PAEEN BEZANID VA CODE RO BA IPHONE SCAN KONID.
APP-E IPHONE-E GHADIMI? CODE-E GHADIMI RO NESHOON BEDE
CODE BARAYE NOSKHE-E GHADIMI: DAR APP-E IPHONE ETTESAL › JOFT KARDAN BA GOOSHI-E ANDROID RO BAZ KONID VA OONJA SCANESH KONID (DOORBIN NEMITOONE IN YEKI RO BAZ KONE).
TCP DEBUGGING (ANDROID 8 TA 10, YA BEDOON-E WI-FI)

GOOSHI RO YEK BAR BA USB BE COMPUTER VASL KONID, DASTOOR-E adb tcpip 5555 RO EJRA KONID VA PAYAM-E KELID RO ROOYE GOOSHI TAEED KONID (ALWAYS ALLOW). BAADESH REGISTER KHODESH BE 127.0.0.1:5555 VASL MISHE. BAAD AZ HAR RESTART-E GOOSHI DASTOOR RO TEKRAR KONID. BARAYE KHAMOOSH KARDAN: adb usb. TA VAGHTI ROSHANE, GOOSHI ROOYE HAR SHABAKEI ETTESAL-E ADB GHABOOL MIKONE KE FAGHAT BA HAMOON TAEED-E KELID MAHFOOZE.
DAR HAAL-E ETTESAL BE ADB ROOYE 127.0.0.1…
VASL SHOD. DAR HAAL-E RAH-ANDAZI-E DASTYAR-E SEDA…
ETTESAL BE ADB ROOYE PORT %1$d NASHOD. AZ COMPUTER adb tcpip %1$d RO EJRA KONID VA KELID RO TAEED KONID.
DEVELOPER OPTIONS › WIRELESS DEBUGGING › PAIR DEVICE WITH PAIRING CODE RO BAZ KONID, BAAD CODE-E 6 RAGHAMI RO INJA VARED KONID.
BA WIRELESS DEBUGGING JOFT SHOD. DAR HAAL-E RAH-ANDAZI-E DASTYAR-E SEDA…
%1$s FARAMOOSH SHAVAD? BAYAD DOBARE JOFT SHE.
SEDAYE TAMAS ANDROID 11 YA JADIDTAR LAZEM DARE. ROOYE IN GOOSHI TAMASHA HANOOZ AZ IPHONE JAVAB DADE, GEREFTE VA GHAT MISHAN, AMMA SEDASHOON ROOYE HAMIN GOOSHI MIMOONE.
SEDAYE TAMAS DAR ANDROID 11 VA 12 AZ MASIR-E ZABT-E TAMAS ESTEFADE MIKONE VA FAGHAT AGE GOOSHI EJAZE BEDE KAR MIKONE. VASAT-E TAMAS TEST RO EJRA KONID.

NARM-AFZAR-E IN GOOSHI DAR TAMAS BE REGISTER SEDAYE TAMAS NADAD, PAS TAMASHA INJA POL NEMISHAN: HANOOZ AZ IPHONE JAVAB DADE, GEREFTE VA GHAT MISHAN, AMMA ROOYE IN GOOSHI MISHNAVID VA HARF MIZANID. YE UPDATE-E SYSTEM, YA TEST VASAT-E TAMAS KE SEDA RO BESHNAVE, SEDAYE TAMAS RO DOBARE ROSHAN MIKONE. AGE TAMASHAYE KHOD-E GOOSHI HAM SEDA NADARAN, YEK BAR GOOSHI RO RESTART KONID.
SEDAYE TAMAS ANDROID 13 YA JADIDTAR LAZEM DARE. ROOYE IN GOOSHI TAMASHA HANOOZ AZ IPHONE JAVAB DADE, GEREFTE VA GHAT MISHAN, AMMA SEDASHOON ROOYE HAMIN GOOSHI MIMOONE.
ROSHAN: REGISTER DAR HAR TAMAS CHECK MIKONE KE SEDAYE SHOMA BE TARAF-E MOGHABEL BERESE VA AGE NARESE BI-SEDA RO KHAMOOSH MIKONE.
ROSHAN, AMMA ROOYE IN GOOSHI ESTEFADE NEMISHE: INJA BI-SEDA KARDAN-E MICROPHONE SEDAYE SHOMA RO HAM BARAYE TARAF-E MOGHABEL GHAT MIKONE, PAS MICROPHONE-E GOOSHI DAR TAMAS ROSHAN MIMOONE.
ROSHAN, AMMA ROOYE IN GOOSHI ESTEFADE NEMISHE: BI-SEDA KARDAN-E MICROPHONE SEDAYE SHOMA RO BARAYE TARAF-E MOGHABEL GHAT KARD. BARAYE AZMAYESH-E DOBARE KHAMOOSH VA ROSHANESH KONID.
MICROPHONE-E IN GOOSHI DAR TAMASHAYE POL-SHODE

REGISTER MICROPHONE VA GOOSHI-E KHOD-E IN TELEPHONE RO AZ TAMAS KHAREJ MIKONE: BA HALAT-E REDIRECT-E ANDROID JAYI KE GOOSHI POSHTIBANI KONE, VAGARNA BA KELID-E KHOD-E SAZANDE-E GOOSHI. CHECK MIKONE HAR DO TARAF KAR KONAN VA YADESH MIMOONE IN GOOSHI CHI EJAZE MIDE.
HALAT-E REDIRECT ROOYE IN GOOSHI KAR NEMIKONE: REGISTER BE JASH MICROPHONE RO BA KELID-E KHOD-E SAZANDE BI-SEDA MIKONE KE SEDAYE SHOMA DAR TAMAS MIMOONE.
IN GOOSHI EJAZE NEMIDE (YA ANDROID 13 LAZEME): MICROPHONESH DAR TAMAS ROSHAN MIMOONE, PAS TOOYE KIF YA JIB NEGAHESH DARID. BARAYE AZMAYESH-E DOBARE HAMIN RO DOBARE ENTEKHAB KONID.
MICROPHONE-E IN GOOSHI DAR TAMAS MIMOONE: MOMKENE TARAF-E MOGHABEL SEDAYE SHOMA RO DO BAR BESHNAVE, HAMRAH BA SEDAYE ATRAF-E IN GOOSHI.
HALAT-E REDIRECT GHATESH KARDE BOOD; DIGE ROOYE IN GOOSHI ESTEFADE NEMISHE
BI-SEDA-E MICROPHONE GHATESH KARDE BOOD; BI-SEDA ROOYE IN GOOSHI KHAMOOSH SHOD
ROOYE IN GOOSHI CHIZI GHATESH NEMIKONE
BARRASI NASHODE (IN GOOSHI NEMITOONE NESHOON BEDE)
CODE-E 6 RAGHAMI-E ZIR-E PAIR DEVICE WITH PAIRING CODE RO VARED KONID.
WIRELESS DEBUGGING WI-FI LAZEM DARE. BE YE WI-FI VASL SHID, PAIR DEVICE WITH PAIRING CODE RO DOBARE BAZ KONID VA CODE-E JADID RO VARED KONID.

PANJERE-E JOFTSAZI PEYDA NASHOD. PAIR DEVICE WITH PAIRING CODE RO ROOYE SAFHE BAZ NEGAH DARID (IN NOTIFICATION RO ROOSH BEKESHID PAEEN YA SPLIT SCREEN) VA VAGHTI NESHOON DADE MISHE CODE RO VARED KONID.
CODE ESHTEBAH BOOD YA MONGHAZI SHODE. PAIR DEVICE WITH PAIRING CODE RO DOBARE BAZ KONID VA CODE-E 6 RAGHAMI-E JADID RO VARED KONID.
JOFT SHOD, AMMA HANOOZ VASL NASHOD (%1$s). TA VAGHTI WIRELESS DEBUGGING ROSHANE REGISTER DOBARE TALASH MIKONE.

YE FILE BA ETELAATI KE BARAYE PEYDA KARDAN-E MOSHKEL-E RAH-ANDAZI, JOFTSAZI, ETTESAL, TAMASHA, SEDAYE TAMAS, PAYAMAKHA, MOKHATABIN YA ESHTERAK-E INTERNET LAZEME. SHOMAREHA, NAMHA, MATN-E PAYAMHA, EMAIL, ADDRESSHA VA KELIDHA HAZF MISHAN.
DAR HAAL-E AMADE-SAZI-E GOZARESH… TA NIM DAGHIGHE TOOL MIKESHE.
GOZARESH AMADE AST (%1$d KB). SHOMAREHA, NAMHA, MATN-E PAYAMHA, EMAIL, ADDRESSHA VA KELIDHA HAZF SHODAN; GHABL AZ ERSAL YE NEGAH BEHESH BENDAZID.
COPY SHOD, BARAYE CLIPBOARD BE %1$d KB KOOTAH SHOD. ESHTERAK KOL-E FILE RO MIFERESTE.
